parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Integrate by parts and reach $ax^2\cos2x+b\int x\cos2x\,dx$. M1*
Obtain $-\frac12x^2\cos2x+\int x\cos2x\,dx$, or equivalent. A1
Complete the integration and obtain $-\frac12x^2\cos2x+\frac12x\sin2x+\frac14\cos2x$, or equivalent. A1
Use limits correctly having integrated twice. DM1*
Obtain answer $\frac18(\pi^2-4)$, or exact equivalent, with no errors seen. A1
